item.title: DeepSeek's New Peak-Off-Peak API Pricing Takes Effect August 17 — Increases Up to 1,100%
item.description: DeepSeek's new API pricing took effect at midnight on August 17, with peak and off-peak rates for V4-Flash and V4-Pro set at a 1:2 ratio.
